summary: Bug hunt across all five channels: tsc, lint, build and 133 smoke tests pass. Fixed two bugs on the Agents page: experiment results were always called views, and the topic feed's empty state talked about money news.
why: The weekly loop judges tests on points of stayed to watch, not views (policy.md); the Experiments tab showed no result for a loop test and mislabelled the rest. Both are bugs the owner sees on a page used daily.

findings.title: Experiment results mislabelled
findings.detail: Every result read '% views'; a weekly-loop result (points, p_on_better) showed nothing.

findings.title: Finance-era copy
findings.detail: Topic feed's empty state said 'Research reads the money news' on every channel.

changes.title: Agents: experiment results in the words they were judged on
changes.detail: '+6.2 points stayed to watch · 84% sure', or a ratio with its own metric; 'adopted' gets a green badge. Smoke test added.

changes.title: Agents: topic feed empty state fits every channel
changes.detail: Speaks about the selected channel's niche. Smoke test added.
